message:
The other night, we had a surprise power outage that lasted a bit longer than expected. I was all set to light candles, but then I remembered my trusty battery-powered lantern and a couple of fully charged power banks. It was a small win, but it saved the day! We enjoyed a cozy evening playing cards by lantern light instead of scrolling our phones in the dark. 

Sometimes, a little prep can turn an inconvenient moment into a fun family memory. What’s your go-to trick for staying comfortable during a blackout? I'd love to hear your tips! 😊
